Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber

sup:70510.body:
Simulated supplier. Dear Hollerau Pumpenwerke team,

Thank you for your reply. We can offer different packages, with price depending on payment terms and index protection. I will not rank my own offers as a sequence of concessions, but here are three alternatives, all for 6,110 units over 12 months from 1 January 2027, DAP, 35 days lead time:

* Option B: €370.96 per unit, 30 days net, with a CU-NOTATION index clause (20% material share, 3% deadband, base month August 2026). This gives you protection if copper falls, and gives us protection if it keeps rising.
* Option C: €363.54 per unit, 60 days net, no index clause. We can extend payment terms if the price reflects the cost of the additional financing.

The copper increase (47.7% over twelve months, 20% of our cost) is the main driver of our position, so we have limited room on price without index protection. sup:70510.subject: Re: Offer for part:350011 - next steps
sup:70510.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for the three alternatives. To answer your question: our priority is total cost, and within that the unit price matters most. Payment days come second. We would prefer no index clause, because it adds volatility for both of us.

We see room for movement on price, for the following reasons:
- Your increase request of 6.5% is well above the 2% level that your pricing committee handles as a standard threshold. Our past renewals with you settled at roughly 1.2% to 1.4%.
- Copper is about 20% of your cost base, so the 47.7% rise explains only part of the requested increase.
- We are offering a 12-month volume commitment of 6,110 pieces, and we are a long-standing, reliable customer.

We would like you to review your price on the 60-day, no-index-clause package (Option C) and tell us the best unit price your pricing committee can approve for it. Please also confirm whether a price is possible for 90 days net, and whether the 5% deadband index variant would earn a lower base price.

Please give us your offer on every term: unit price, payment days and index clause.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

sup:70510.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
sup:70510.body:
Simulated supplier. Dear Hollerau Pumpenwerke team,

Thank you for your clear priorities. Here are our offers on each term, all for 6,110 units over 12 months from 1 January 2027, DAP, 35 days lead time:

* 60 days net, no index clause: €363.54 per unit. This is the best price we can currently support for this package. The additional 30 days of financing against our 30-day quote is already reflected in that figure.
* 60 days net, CU-NOTATION index clause with 5% deadband (20% material share, base month August 2026): €363.54 per unit. We cannot lower the base price for the wider deadband, because it still leaves us exposed to copper moves of up to 5%. We would only consider a lower base price where the index protection is tighter.
* 90 days net, no index clause: €352.41 per unit. Please note that this is a lower price than the 60-day offer, as it is the better fit with a longer payment term for you; we would need to see how it fits our commercial approvals before confirming it as final.

On your points: the copper rise (47.7%, 20% of our cost) is only one part of our cost pressure. LCI-C rose 2.7% and PPI-C241 rose 6.5%, so our request is not driven by copper alone. We appreciate the long relationship and the 12-month volume commitment, and these are reflected in the prices above.

Please let us know which package you would like to proceed with.

Best regards,
